en_how: Three.js draws an original small drone (hull, four arms, rotors, battery, gimbal camera) entirely as glowing wireframe (EdgesGeometry with additive blending) floating above a circular projector ringed with tick marks; at the start a scan plane sweeps upward, using a clipping plane to reveal the model; then four parts are locked one by one on a timetable: Canvas 2D targeting brackets shrink and straighten around each part, the part pops out along its own direction, a leader line runs to a side label, and the digits roll from noise into the real value one place at a time; the value that has just locked becomes the only warm orange in the frame.
